description: This PHP source file defines a Helpers class containing static utility methods for mathematical and validation operations within the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically in the MathTrig calculation namespace.

classes.name: Helpers
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for handling mathematical validations and computations, such as division, numeric validation, sign determination, and error handling.

methods.name: verySmallDenominator
methods.description: Performs division and returns either the quotient, or an error if the denominator is too small.

methods.name: validateNumericNullBool
methods.description: Validates a value as numeric, handling null/boolean, and throws an error if invalid.

methods.name: validateNumericNullSubstitution
methods.description: Validates a value as numeric, substituting a default if null and not numeric, or throws an error.

methods.name: validateNotNegative
methods.description: Checks if a number is >= 0, throws an error otherwise.

methods.name: validatePositive
methods.description: Checks if a number > 0, throws an error otherwise.

methods.name: validateNotZero
methods.description: Checks if a number is != 0, throws an error if zero.

methods.name: returnSign
methods.description: Returns the sign of a number as 1, 0, or -1.

methods.name: getEven
methods.description: Returns the nearest even multiple of the input number.

methods.name: numberOrNan
methods.description: Returns NaN error or the result value if not NaN.
